new_value: Peer-counting density estimator landed (spec R-02a-117 / 2a.10.3): (1) Rust PeerDensityTracker in rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs — rolling-window tracker of distinct [u8;8] peers over RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes, no_std-safe via heapless::LinearMap<([u8;8],u64), 256> (ponytail comment: O(n) stalest-first eviction when full; upgrade path a proper LRU); prune drops entries whose last_seen < current_sf-32; peer_count() prunes-then-counts; estimate_density() feeds the count through the EXISTING estimate_density formula (no duplication of the loss/RSSI bonus logic). (2) Python PeerDensityTracker in ccp.py with identical semantics (dict-based, importable constants). (3) python/src/lichen/constants.py gained DENSITY_PER_BONUS_PERMILLE=100 and DENSITY_RSSI_BONUS_DBM=-90 (previously Rust-only) and ccp.py imports them + RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF from constants — cross-language constant parity. Tests: Rust peer_tracker_counts_distinct_and_prunes_window (distinct counting + window slide to superframe 40 prunes all but one) and peer_tracker_density_matches_formula_vectors (5/7/8/255 pinned from the ccp16_load_balance.json density_estimate vectors, incl. the 252-peer cap case — first cut had a 62-vs-255 assert bug, caught and fixed); Python mirrored in test_ccp.py.
